strengths.home: Seventh on 15 points, unbeaten in five home games; lost 0-1 to Union SG; xGA 1.10.
strengths.away: 17th on 7 points (W2 D1 L8, 13-24), all five away games lost; four draws and a loss in last five against Genk.

pick.text: Schalke’s scoring struggles make backing a Stuttgart win with a clean sheet an attractive choice.

preview.synopsis: Schalke's goal drought against a stronger Stuttgart. The writer picks a Stuttgart win with a clean sheet.

strengths.home: Winless in seven (D2 L5), six points and in the relegation zone, no goal in four home games; coach under pressure. Becker may miss out.
strengths.away: First meeting in over three years; Stiller and Vagnoman may miss out.

preview.author: Nathan Evans

pick.text: With Newcastle’s games being low-scoring and Arsenal’s defence near-impenetrable, this match could produce under 2.5 goals.

preview.synopsis: Low-scoring Newcastle games and a tight Arsenal defence. The writer picks under 2.5 goals.

strengths.home: Two wins in last eight (D2 L4), 12th; seven home defeats in 2026, two successive 0-1 home losses. Joelinton out.
strengths.away: Near-impenetrable defence; Arsenal have lost three of their last five away league H2Hs. Saka injured, Dowman suspended.

preview.synopsis: Hearts have the head-to-head edge but are conceding freely. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Fifth on 17 points, lost 2-1 at St Johnstone; Miller (5 goals), Kingsley and Renaud out.
strengths.away: Fourth on 20 points, lost 5-2 at home to Falkirk; have won the last four meetings with Dundee; make many errors leading to goals.

preview.synopsis: Utrecht lead the head-to-head (won 3-0 last time) but are leaking goals. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: 14th on 12 points (21-34), lost 2-3 to Nijmegen, winless in three; shaky defensively. Amofa out.
strengths.away: 10th on 15 points, lost 2-5 to PSV but four unbeaten away; good through-passing.

preview.synopsis: Feyenoord are overwhelming favourites. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Second on 25 points (W7 D4 L1, 36-17), best xG (2.59) and shots on target in the league; won 18 straight home games against Excelsior. Hadj Moussa doubtful, St. Juste out.
strengths.away: 15th on 11 points (16-29), five straight losses scoring 0.2 per match; Groen suspended.

preview.synopsis: Rapid are overwhelming favourites. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: 10th on 10 points (W2 D4 L6, 9-29), lost 2-1 at Lustenau, six games without a win; most yellow cards. Guerti, Owusu out, Oberleitner suspended.
strengths.away: Leaders on 33 points (W11 L1, 39-9), seven straight wins including 6-0 over Wolfsberger; beat Grazer 8-0 earlier this season.

preview.synopsis: First-round playoff; the home side are better in the standings, the last five meetings average 3.0 goals. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

preview.synopsis: Bochum have the head-to-head edge and the sturdier defence. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Ninth on 12 points (W2 D6 L3), lost 1-4 at Magdeburg, four games without a win; Oppie suspended. Lost four of last five against Bochum.
strengths.away: Eighth on 14 points, won 3-2 against Karlsruhe, best shots-on-target-conceded record in the league; won the most recent meeting.

preview.synopsis: Sion are better on form, but Servette are hard to beat in this fixture. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Third on 26 points (W8 D2 L3, 29-18), won 4-0 at Vaduz, best big-chance creation. Cognat, Stevanovic and Fofana out.
strengths.away: Sixth on 17 points (17-16), 0-0 with Zurich; best shots-on-target-conceded record; unbeaten against Sion for a while (three draws in last five). Top scorer Mutandwa out.

preview.synopsis: Brugge are far stronger, but all five recent meetings saw both teams score (4.4 goals per game). AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.away: Second on 28 points (W9 D1 L1, 27-9), 1-1 with Anderlecht, seven unbeaten, 3.0 goals per match lately.

pick.text: Lille have seen plenty of their home games in 2026 end level, and as these sides are difficult to split, a draw wouldn’t come as a great surprise.

strengths.home: Lost one league game this season (W6 D3), lost one of last 12 home league games (many draws); best start in 70 years if they win; have lost four straight H2Hs to Lyon. Igamane and Ueda nearing returns.
strengths.away: Level with Lille on 50 points in 2026; long-term absentees include Morton, Sulc and Openda.

preview.author: Peter Stavrinou

pick.text: Both teams to score and over 2.5 goals seems worth a punt here, as that bet would have won in six of the last seven H2Hs.

preview.synopsis: Both teams to score and over 2.5 goals in six of the last seven meetings. The writer picks over 2.5 goals.

strengths.home: Five winless league games (D3 L2), seventh, but unbeaten in seven home games and in 12 H2Hs with Auxerre; Golovin injured.
strengths.away: Dioubate returns from suspension; have not beaten Monaco in 12 meetings (W0 D3 L9).

preview.author: Chris Wilson

pick.text: Lens have had two weeks to stew on their nosedive in form, and with an impressive H2H record in tow, a home win seems a logical pick.

preview.synopsis: Lens are in a crisis but have a strong H2H record at home. The writer picks a Lens win.

strengths.home: Lost three in a row (including 9-1 at Como), new manager Digard after Cahuzac; eight defeats already this season; won eight of last ten Ligue 1 H2Hs with Toulouse. Bulatovic injured, Jorgensen doubtful.
strengths.away: Won 3-1 against Strasbourg last time out; have lost eight of the last ten Ligue 1 meetings with Lens.

preview.author: Tom Penn

pick.text: Given Strasbourg’s defensive issues, backing Brest to score over 1.5 goals looks like a strong option.

preview.synopsis: Strasbourg are shaky defensively. The writer backs Brest to score over 1.5 goals (a team total).

strengths.home: Five losses in six (lost 3-1 at Toulouse), manager sacked, new coach Matos; joint-worst defence (22 conceded), two points above the drop but lost one of last four at home. Jorgensen and Reyna doubtful.
strengths.away: Won both H2Hs last season, three wins in last four trips to Strasbourg; no new availability issues.

preview.author: Sridhar Bhamidi

pick.text: Napoli’s strong H2H form could give them the edge here, so backing a home win seems sensible.

preview.synopsis: Napoli are struggling but have a strong history against Torino. The writer picks a Napoli win.

strengths.home: Five wins in 15 games (D3 L7), nine points off the top four, 1-1 with Lazio; lengthy injury list; unbeaten in 14 home games against Torino and lost two of 22 H2Hs.
strengths.away: Vlasic and Belghali may be out through injury.

preview.synopsis: Two struggling sides; Waregem arrive on six straight defeats. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: 14th on 11 points, six straight defeats (lost 4-1 at St. Truiden), five losses in last five; Mbodji suspended, Paugain injured.
strengths.away: 13th on 11 points, drew 2-2 with Lommel, one win in last five; concede many shots on target. Won four of last five against Waregem.

preview.author: Nathan Evans

pick.selection: Real Madrid to win and score 3+
pick.text: With Real Madrid in formidable goalscoring form and Celta Vigo poor on their travels, backing Real Madrid to win and score 3+ goals seems like a good option.

preview.synopsis: Real Madrid are in formidable form. The writer picks Real Madrid to win and score 3+ goals.

strengths.away: Poor away form; up to five first-teamers injured including Roman.

preview.synopsis: Rangers are clear favourites on form and history. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.away: Second on 27 points (W8 D3 L1, 21-9), 10 unbeaten, won 2-0 at St. Mirren; unbeaten in 16 against Motherwell.

preview.synopsis: Heerenveen are in better form; Groningen won last season's meeting 2-0. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Ninth on 15 points (29-28), lost 4-3 at AZ, one win in last five; worst for big chances conceded and many errors leading to goals. Hateboer suspended, Hernes out.
strengths.away: Sixth on 21 points (24-16), won 5-3 against Feyenoord, four straight wins.

preview.synopsis: Two bottom-half sides; Telstar have lost all of the last five meetings. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: 16th on 10 points (W2 D4 L6), 2-2 at Sittard, scoring and conceding 2.6 per match lately; strong big-chance conversion but lost all of the last five meetings with Zwolle. Mendes and Alders doubts.
strengths.away: 13th on 12 points (13-24), 1-1 at Willem II, no away win in four; xG only 1.12.

preview.synopsis: First-round playoff; Dallas have the seed and home record, Portland are in form. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Second in the West on 58 points (W16 D10 L8, 62-51), unbeaten at home against Portland since 2019; many yellow cards. Ibeagha and Antony doubts, Mosquera out.
strengths.away: Seventh on 46 points (62-61), four wins in last five including 2-0 at Austin; concede many shots on target.

preview.synopsis: Miami are the better side but Columbus arrive on a six-game winning run; the last five meetings average 3.8 goals. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Second in the East on 60 points (80-59), 3-3 with Charlotte; best big-chance creation and through-balls in the league. Reguilon and Ayala doubts, Silvetti out.
strengths.away: Seventh on 47 points (59-52), six straight wins including 4-3 at Chicago; Abou Ali (5 goals) out.
